claims.text: The types of offensive content explored include hate speech, cyberbullying, cyber-aggression, and toxic comments.
The research identifies offensive messages in a hierarchical manner, focusing on the type and target of the content.
Previous studies have primarily focused on specific aspects of offensive language rather than a comprehensive approach.
